title: An image encoded as sound (PySSTV)
description: PySSTV encodes an original grayscale image into an 8.95-second Robot8BW signal. Inspect the actual WAV spectrum and enable Listen to hear it.
description_ko: PySSTV로 직접 만든 회색조 그림을 8.95초 Robot8BW 신호로 부호화했어요. 실제 WAV의 스펙트럼을 살펴보고 Listen을 켜서 들어 보세요.
prompt: An image encoded as sound. Inspect locally computed output and rerun the included recipe for new inputs.
made_with: PySSTV==0.5.7, numpy==2.2.6, Pillow==11.3.0; verified local CPU computation
summary: PySSTV encodes an original grayscale image into an 8.95-second Robot8BW signal.
